Lab usage from vertical-cloud-lab/byu-vcl and vertical-cloud-lab/powder-doser issues/comments and committed rig-check frames. No official drawing exists publicly, so every panel dimension except the bumper size is SCALED FROM PHOTOS: lateral sizes against the panel's own outer width, assumed equal to the stock FXi-10 top outline (184 mm, the value in the lab's current model); fore-aft against the breeze-break post spacing (128 mm c-c) in the side photo; thickness from the foreshortened hole wall in the lab's 4032x3024 photo. Treat all 'estimated_keys' as +/-10-15%.

autotrickler_v4_lid.description: 'V4 Acrylic Top Panel' (AutoTrickler part, USD 40): a flat clear acrylic plate that REPLACES the A&D FX-i breeze-break top plate. It sits directly on the tops of the four vertical arms, located by a groove machined in its underside (no pins/clips; the V3 'panel clips' are removed). Same plan outline as the stock top (bowed rounded square following the breeze-break side panels) plus one 'extended tab' at the rear. Three clear self-adhesive rubber bumpers are stuck on its TOP face (left, right, and on the rear tab); the V4 housing's three contact points rest on them (the housing is not fastened). One round through-hole, centred left-right and forward of centre, through which the housing's white funnel hangs down toward the cup. No raised boss, no centre cap, no funnel/chute integral to the panel. The breeze-break FRONT side panel is left out in AutoTrickler use.

dims_mm.outline_shape: same as stock FXi-10 top plate outline (bowed rounded square); the measured top-panel width is ~95% of the bowed side-panel bulge width in the manual photo
dims_mm.bottom_groove: continuous channel around the perimeter on the UNDERSIDE that drops over the tops of the four vertical arms; inset roughly 8-12 mm from the outer edge (estimate); width and depth unknown (suggest ~5 mm wide x ~2-3 mm deep as a modelling placeholder)
dims_mm.note_on_mass: 100 g (Shopify 'weight') would imply ~3 mm acrylic for this outline; the photo-scaled thickness is ~6 mm (~220 g). Shopify weights are often placeholders; prefer the photo value until measured.
dims_mm.rear_tab_shape: trapezoid, wider at the root; centred on x=0; carries the third bumper
dims_mm.hole_diameter_check: hole/panel-width ratio = 0.25 in two independent photos (OEM manual p4 photo: 179.5/717 px; lab photo 2026-08-11: 328/1290 px at the hole depth) -> 46 mm if the panel is 184 mm wide

holes.shape: round, plain straight-walled through-hole (edge looks milled/frosted)
holes.purpose: the housing's white funnel (O.D. ~32-37 mm) passes down through it; the trickler tubes themselves stay ABOVE the panel inside the housing
holes.confidence: low-medium (scaled; diameter ratio 0.25 of panel width measured in manual photo; position from side photo +21.6 mm vs post midpoint and manual photo ~+28 mm)

raised_features.type: clear rubber dome bumper on the extended tab

autotrickler_v4_lid.material: clear acrylic (PMMA) sheet; milled edges; bumpers clear silicone/rubber (Scotch SP951-type)
autotrickler_v4_lid.colour: transparent/clear (V4 beta prototype used an opaque white panel; production is clear so the green 'charge complete' LED shines down through it)
autotrickler_v4_lid.fits: A&D FX-i / FZ-i small breeze break: FX/FZ-120i, 200i, 300i, 500i and FX-123 (AutoTrickler compatibility list); same part for all of them. 'Not compatible with V3' (the V3 sat on the stock white top plate using 'V3 panel clips'; the Area 419 Lexan lid fits only V2/V3 housings). Sits where the stock top plate sits: its underside groove lands on the tops of the 4 vertical arms, so its underside is at the stock plate's seat height minus the groove depth. On the lab's HR-100A it fits because the lab fitted the FXi-10 small breeze break (AutoTrickler itself says the HR series is not supported electrically/speed-wise).

sources.quote: Place the top panel on the platform. If you have AutoTrickler V3 panel clips, remove them. The groove on the bottom of the panel fits directly on top of the vertical arms. The three bumpers already attached to the panel will face up, and the extended tab faces to the rear.
Install the left, right, and rear panels, leaving the front open.

Install the funnel into the bottom of the housing. An o-ring is captive within the housing. Push and twist the funnel groove into the o-ring. Position the housing on the top panel. Center the left and right contact points on the bumpers. Center the rear of the housing on the panel. Verify the housing rests on all three bumpers properly and has a slight upward angle relative to the panel.

autotrickler_v4_system.summary: Single housing (two NEMA-17 steppers driving a large spiral-grooved 'auger' tube for bulk and a small tube for the final kernels, both via toothed belts; electronics integrated). Hopper sits on the REAR block; tubes run roughly front-back along the centreline, slightly tilted; both drop into the front U-channel block, whose bottom carries the white funnel that hangs through the panel hole into a glass cup on the pan.
autotrickler_v4_system.housing_support: 3-point: left and right contact points (under the motor plates) on the side bumpers, rear contact on the tab bumper; free-standing, lifts off without disturbing the scale.
autotrickler_v4_system.tube_angle: approximately horizontal; manual: 'has a slight upward angle relative to the panel'; flow is tuned by tilting ('The housing needs to be tilted down/up'), with the scale levelled by its bubble as the starting point. No numeric angle published.

funnel.source: Printables 236386 remodel ('more like the original'), STL measured
funnel.fit: push-and-twist into a captive o-ring in the housing bottom

autotrickler_v4_system.funnel_tip_height: estimate: ~15-20 mm below the panel underside, just at/above the cup rim (manual cover photo, FX-120i)
autotrickler_v4_system.cup: glass shot-glass cup (holds ~400 gr = ~26 g powder) with a white 3D-printed ring-and-handle; top O.D. ~45 mm (estimate). Cup sits on a white printed chevron 'centering tray' stuck to the pan, front edge near the pan's raised border, so the cup sits slightly IN FRONT of the funnel centre (optional rear position puts it behind).
autotrickler_v4_system.platform_bumpers: 4 more 1/2 in x 9/64 in bumpers go UNDER the breeze-break base plate at the corner circles (not on the lid).
autotrickler_v4_system.overall: FAQ: 'The V4 AutoTrickler is about 18 inches tall and the footprint of the scale is about 9 by 11 inches.' Shipping weight 1.5 kg.
autotrickler_v4_system.v3_comparison: V3 = two separate units sitting on the STOCK white A&D top plate with 'V3 panel clips' (YouTube 'AutoTrickler V3 vs V4 (beta)' thumbnail); the V4 beta used an opaque white panel; production V4 panel is clear and 'Not compatible with V3'.
